clusters.title: Ïawphñiaw / Phñiaw / Nongrum / Rumnong / Nongneng
clusters.summary_khasi: Mih na ka Phñiaw ha Rymbai/Tongseng bad pur sha Shella, Sohra, bad Sepngi. Ki Nongneng/Nengnong bad Nongrum/Rumnong ki ïalong shikur bad ki Ïawphñiaw.
clusters.summary_english: Originates from Ka Phñiaw. Nongrum, Rumnong, Nongneng, Nengnong, and Nongrem share the same bloodline with Ïawphñiaw.

clusters.title: Tariang / Nongtariang / Umdor / Nongrum
clusters.summary_khasi: Ka kur Tariang ka don 5 kpoh bad ki ïalong shikur bad ki Nongrum (ha Ri Khasi) bad Umdor (Jait Binan).
clusters.summary_english: Tariang has 5 internal kpoh and is shikur with Nongrum and Umdor (Jait Binan), with lineage-specific prohibitions in Jowai.
clusters.citation: E.R. Tariang & Rev. I. Kharkongngor (2004), Entries #104, #114 (Pages 99, 102)
